subject: SentinelVault security qualification — post-call recap
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rider <alex.rider@sentinelvault.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 14:15:00 -0700
Subject: SentinelVault security qualification — post-call recap

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the 35-minute call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on acceptance criteria and timelines.

Key pain points you called out:
- Long-term retention requirement: 7 years for logs and transaction traces (immutable, exportable).
- Auditability: Per-tenant audit logs and an attestation trail for actions (not just aggregate metrics).
- Data residency + separation: EU residency requirement for EU tenants; option for VPC/private deployment.
- Pen test & compliance: You want vendor pen test report and plan to run a customer-facing pen test window; SOC 2 attestation is required before production.

What Redwood can provide (high level):
- SOC 2 report and control summary (I attached a one-page SOC 2 summary).
- Audit log retention controls + configurable retention buckets; we support export in NDJSON/CSV and S3-compatible push.
- Private deployment options (VPC + customer KMS) and Dedicated pools for isolation.
- We maintain an evidence matrix that maps common DDQ asks to specific artifacts (attached).

Open questions we agreed to resolve:
1) Scope of SOC 2 you need (in-scope systems): app, control plane, or also pipeline/transforms?
2) Acceptance for pen test: will SentinelVault run their own pentest or accept a Redwood third-party report for initial go-live?
3) Exact egress criteria and whether you require a signed DPA prior to any test access.

Proposed immediate actions / timeline:
- Today: Sending the SOC2 summary + evidence matrix (attached).
- Mon 11/2: Grace + Irene to share a draft DPA for SentinelVault review.
- Week of 11/9: Tentative pen-test window discussion (we can slot a remediation period after the test).
- Week of 11/16: If SOC2 scope is agreed, we can schedule a short tech deep-dive with our security engineer to map artifacts.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (summary), evidence_matrix.xlsx (artifact mapping), dpa_draft_for_review.docx (initial DPA).

If this matches your notes, can we lock a 30-min follow-up on Mon 11/2 to go over the DPA and designate the security contact at SentinelVault who will own the pen-test coordination?

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Rider <alex.rider@sentinelvault.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@sentinelvault.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SentinelVault security qualification — post-call recap

Grace — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. High level confirmation and a couple clarifications from our side: 

Confirmation:
- 7-year retention is non-negotiable for certain transaction logs (we'll provide the list).
- We do require per-tenant audit logs (so we can present per-customer evidence for regulators).

Clarifications / asks:
1) SOC 2 scope: we need the control plane + serving layer in scope (not just the management plane). Is that what your SOC 2 covers?
2) For pen testing: SentinelVault prefers to run our own external pentest (third-party) prior to production. We need to understand the support you provide (staging environment, PII redaction, test window SLA).
3) DPA: we'll provide our legal redlines but require a clause for data retention and deletion confirmation after termination.

Next steps from our side: Priya will coordinate internally on the asset list and provide a contact for the pen-test ops. We'll take a look at the DPA draft — thanks for sending it.

Alex Rider
Director, Security & Compliance | SentinelVault
alex.rider@sentinelvault.com | +1 (628) 555-0112
